reuse.why: Hooks the rule into the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked precondition that all six provider link functions already call before anything is created.

duplication.why: No copied logic; only a second lookup of the upgrading account row, which linkBankSyncAccount also reads later.

placement.why: The shared pre-link guard is the right layer (it runs before findOrCreateBank and sync), though the closed check now lives in a function whose name only describes the already-linked rule.

scope.why: Guard, one test and a release note only.

maintainability.why: Small and covers every provider, but the guard's name no longer says what it checks; a rename or separate assertion would read better.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by every link*Account handler
